title: Research and Markets - Global Automotive Semiconductor Market Growth Opportunities 2017-2022 Featuring NXP Semiconductor, Infineon Technologies, Renesas Electronics, ST Microelectronics and Texas Instruments
关键词: Growth Opportunities in the Global Automotive Semiconductor Market
主要内容: Research and Markets has announced the addition of the "Growth Opportunities in the Global Automotive Semiconductor Market" report to their offering. The global automotive semiconductor market is expected to reach an estimated $45.9 billion by 2022, growing at a CAGR of 6.4% from 2017 to 2022. Major drivers include increasing vehicle production, higher semiconductor content per vehicle, growing demand for advanced safety and comfort systems, and stricter CO2 regulations. Emerging trends include high-efficiency power semiconductors and smaller single-chips for radar sensors. Companies profiled include NXP semiconductor N.V, Infineon Technologies AG, Renesas Electronics Corporations, ST Microelectronics, and Texas Instruments Incorporated. Several are pursuing mergers and acquisitions. The sensor and discrete power segments are forecast to show above-average growth, while integrated circuits will remain the largest segment.
